statement.excerpt: P.S. In other news, early generative AI darling Character.AI has filed for bankruptcy, and Coreweave bonds have reached 15%, suggesting that credit markets have had enough.
statement.document_title: It remains “very difficult [to find] actual, materially measurable financial impacts” from spending on AI, per new study

our_interpretation: Character.AI means the company operating the service, including its legal corporate name.
The claim concerns a bankruptcy filing made by the post date, October 14, 2026. No earliest filing date is specified, so the target period has an open start.
Filing for bankruptcy does not require the service to have shut down or the company to have completed liquidation.
criteria.support_condition: A court record, company announcement, or reliable report establishes that Character.AI's operating company filed a bankruptcy petition on or before October 14, 2026.
criteria.contradiction_condition: Authoritative records or a substantiated correction establish that the reported filing did not occur by October 14, 2026, or concerned a different company.
